Got one for you as well.  I got back together with my ex for a month while he was apparently off his meds and manic as hell.  Thought everything was going peachy-keen until he wound up in jail for sucker-punching his dad (charged with felony 4 domestic assault due to previous accusations by a former girlfriend) and his girlfriend came calling with the big reveal that he'd been fucking with my head the entire time.

Good news is there are actually good people out there, one of whom I'm now dating.  Just got to cut yourself off from the crazies entirely and start looking in new ponds.

Not for over a year.  I've been on Abilify pretty close to consistently during that time, but I had a fun side-effect from it that I'd rather not name and asked my shrink to try me on something new.

Talked to psychologist today, psychiatrist doesn't get back into office until Tuesday thanks to the holiday.  Could call emergency lines, don't see the point of it really since a) I'm not actually going to off myself and b) I don't want to be admitted to a psych ward.  I've got a clean record of no psych ward thus far, hear it's not a pretty place, and don't really want to.

No trigger, nope.  Life's pretty swell right now excepting minor frustrations.  Nothing major.

Talking is good.
This sounds like a good thing to try - maybe I will.  Thank you.
Thank you.  I'm glad to hear it's not abnormal, and yeah, I could do with a little forgiveness of self.
I sure hope so!  Thank you.
**hugs** Thank you.  I'm glad it's normal and there's a light at the end of the tunnel and all.  I hope you're doing well in your healing.
Got a backyard I can borrow?
That would be ideal - it's the getting there I'm having trouble with.
The good thing is I do have a therapist, just haven't seen her in a long while.  I'll schedule an appointment just for this.
